tonight.headline: Monangai went for Love; the Vikings are still on the bench
body: Bad news first: at 15:18 UTC you dropped Kyle Monangai, 80% rostered, to add Jordan Love — the second time in two days a skill player went while the Vikings' defence, on bye and now idle behind the Patriots, stayed. Love is a sound answer to Allen's Week 7 bye (Green Bay are off in Week 11). Monangai missed practice again Thursday and would not have played this week. Do not reclaim him: reversing a move made this morning gains nothing.

This week is still in order. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0, and no starter carries a tag. Bok-aneers reset their lineup at 15:18-15:24 UTC and now project 109.5, up from 89.6 this morning; ESPN has you at 59%, down from 70%.

case.label: Where it can still go wrong
case.body: McLaurin is the last to lock, Monday 18:15, and Washington's Thursday practice line for him was not found. Diggs missed Thursday again (NBC, 15 Oct), so if McLaurin plays his share grows.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A starter added to Friday's report. The only eligible bench back is Kamara (limited Wednesday and Thursday, back); there is no receiver behind your starters this week — Jefferson is on bye.

whatWentWrong.title: Monangai was dropped; the idle defence was kept again
whatWentWrong.lead: Love was added at 15:18 UTC for Allen's Week 7 bye. The drop was Monangai, not the Vikings' defence on bye.

case.label: What it cost
case.body: Little this week: Monangai did not practise Wednesday or Thursday with the thumb and toe (NBC, 14 and 15 Oct). The cost is later — Swift and Monangai shared Chicago's backfield, and Monangai carried 30 times in Week 4 (archive). He is on waivers until Saturday 01:00 Mexico City.

case.label: Why the Vikings matter
case.body: Two drops in two days (Addison, then Monangai) have left a second defence sitting behind the Patriots. It is the roster's only idle spot and the drop for any add next Tuesday.

case.label: Why nothing in Do first
case.body: Reclaiming Monangai would reverse a move made the same morning; the runbook's churn rule says that has never gained anything here.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Monangai claimed by a rival and outscoring your started second back in two of Weeks 7-9 (archive) — then the drop cost a starter, not a bench spot.
